# Sofascore
> Sofascore is a live sports scores and statistics platform covering football, tennis, basketball, and many other sports worldwide.

Sofascore provides real-time results, fixtures, standings, player ratings, match statistics, and tournament coverage across major international leagues and competitions. The site also includes editorial content, TV and streaming guides, and product information for its mobile apps and widgets.

## Core Platform
- [Live scores homepage](https://www.sofascore.com/): Main entry point for live scores, schedules, standings, and trending matches across sports.
- [Favorites](https://www.sofascore.com/favorites): Personalized page for following selected teams, players, and competitions.
- [Trending](https://www.sofascore.com/trending): Discovery page highlighting popular live and upcoming events.
- [TV guide](https://www.sofascore.com/tv-guide): Broadcast listings for live sports events and viewing availability.
- [News](https://www.sofascore.com/news): Editorial coverage, previews, analysis, and sports news articles.

## Football
- [Football](https://www.sofascore.com/football): Football live scores, fixtures, standings, and match statistics from global competitions.
- [Premier League](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/football/england/premier-league/17): Competition hub for Premier League matches, table, top players, and form.
- [UEFA Champions League](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/football/europe/uefa-champions-league/7): Tournament page with fixtures, knockout rounds, standings, and statistics.
- [LaLiga](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/football/spain/laliga/8): Spanish top-flight competition page with results, table, and team details.
- [Serie A](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/football/italy/serie-a/23): Italian league overview with fixtures, standings, and player performance data.
- [Bundesliga](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/football/germany/bundesliga/35): German league page with match results, rankings, and season statistics.
- [FIFA World Cup](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/football/world/world-championship/16): International tournament page for fixtures, groups, and knockout stage results.

## Basketball
- [Basketball](https://www.sofascore.com/basketball): Basketball live scores, schedules, standings, and player statistics.
- [NBA](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/basketball/usa/nba/132): NBA competition page with scores, standings, and team form.
- [EuroLeague](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/basketball/europe/euroleague/233): European club basketball tournament page with fixtures and standings.
- [NCAA Men](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/basketball/usa/ncaa-men/341): College basketball results, rankings, and match details.
- [ACB](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/basketball/spain/acb/219): Spanish basketball league page with standings and game statistics.

## Tennis
- [Tennis](https://www.sofascore.com/tennis): Tennis live scores, draws, schedules, rankings context, and match statistics.
- [ATP](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/tennis/atp): ATP tournament coverage and live match tracking.
- [WTA](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/tennis/wta): WTA tournament coverage with schedules and results.
- [Australian Open](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/tennis/atp/australian-open/2368): Grand Slam tournament page with draw and match results.
- [Wimbledon](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/tennis/atp/wimbledon/2367): Wimbledon coverage with live scores and tournament progression.
- [US Open](https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/tennis/atp/us-open/2366): US Open page with fixtures, results, and player matchups.

## Other Sports
- [American football](https://www.sofascore.com/american-football): Live scores, schedules, and standings for American football competitions.
- [Baseball](https://www.sofascore.com/baseball): Baseball live scores, fixtures, standings, and game statistics.
- [Ice hockey](https://www.sofascore.com/ice-hockey): Ice hockey results, schedules, standings, and match details.
- [Handball](https://www.sofascore.com/handball): Handball live scores and tournament coverage with standings and fixtures.
- [Volleyball](https://www.sofascore.com/volleyball): Volleyball scores, schedules, standings, and competition pages.
- [Rugby](https://www.sofascore.com/rugby): Rugby union and league results with fixtures and standings.
- [MMA](https://www.sofascore.com/mma): MMA event schedules, results, and fighter-related coverage.
- [Motorsport](https://www.sofascore.com/motorsport): Motorsport event results and schedules across racing series.
- [Cricket](https://www.sofascore.com/cricket): Cricket live scores, fixtures, standings, and match summaries.
- [Darts](https://www.sofascore.com/darts): Darts results and schedules for major tournaments.
- [Snooker](https://www.sofascore.com/snooker): Snooker live scores, tournament brackets, and match results.
- [Table tennis](https://www.sofascore.com/table-tennis): Table tennis scores, schedules, and tournament tracking.

## Editorial and Guides
- [News hub](https://www.sofascore.com/news): Central news index for articles across sports and competitions.
- [Football news](https://www.sofascore.com/news/category/football): Football-specific news, previews, and analysis.
- [Basketball news](https://www.sofascore.com/news/category/basketball): Basketball news and editorial coverage.
- [Tennis news](https://www.sofascore.com/news/category/tennis): Tennis articles, previews, and tournament coverage.
- [Sofascore Academy](https://www.sofascore.com/news/academy): Educational content explaining metrics, ratings, and sports analysis concepts.
